steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Editor open on the demo project with the bridge answering ping, on a host with a real display (not headless). screenshot_viewport reads the editor viewport pixels and returns a base64 PNG as MCP image content — it needs an interactive GPU session. This scenario is optional: on a headless / CI agent with no display the capture fails (transport error or an empty result) and that is a documented skip, not a milestone blocker. Filter to Required · core to exclude this scenario from the closeout gate.

steps.title: Expected outcomes
items: The result is MCP image content (a base64 PNG) with no isError flag.
Result metadata carries _source: "live" (screenshot_viewport routes to the running bridge).
On a headless host: the capture fails with a transport error or empty image — record the skip in the actual step (this scenario is optional, so a skip is not a regression).

steps.title: Paste / attach the captured viewport PNG (or note the headless skip)
